svg.aria-label: Five box-and-whisker plots with 707 individual observations. Each row has its own stated measurement boundary.
svg.title: Five kinds of wait: 707 retained operations
svg.desc: Five measured distributions on a logarithmic time axis: 351 embedding requests, 90 source-extraction processes, 90 Theory processes, 88 Jev requests and 88 Sol inspection turns. Boxes show the middle half, lines the median, diamonds the mean, whiskers the 1.5-IQR range and dots individual observations. Timer boundaries differ; this is not a controlled end-to-end speedup.
